verdict.rationale: Snowflake docs confirm a Query History page in Snowsight for monitoring individual/grouped queries over the last 14 days and an Access History view for read/write lineage, which are adjacent to query diagnostics, but the evidence pack never cites Snowflake's dedicated 'Query Profile' graphical execution-plan feature (operator tree, bytes scanned, spilling, pruning stats) that data engineers typically use to root-cause slow/expensive queries. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the Query Profile / execution plan visualization, cost/performance breakdown per operator, and independent hands-on confirmation that it surfaces the causes of slowness.
